fields.cooldownMs: nonnegative integer from actual skill definition
fields.resourcePoolId: null only for NONE; otherwise explicit pool on this turret
fields.resourceCost: nonnegative integer, zero only for NONE in spending profiles
fields.normalRegenModelId: declared resource definition; no invented regeneration from item possession

manaAndCooldownModel.commit: commit cost and cooldown once at the skill activation success boundary; post-commit interruption follows that skill definition, not blanket automatic refund
manaAndCooldownModel.manaModifiers: MANA resources only unless an explicit future balance rule authorizes ENERGY mapping

unitConvention.rounding: Integer value is authoritative; display percent = bps / 100

statAggregation.baseStats: Sum equipment basic modifiers and applicable set modifiers for the same stat before final combat aggregation
statAggregation.uniqueAndEnchantEffects: Separate proc/effect layers; not silently included in base stat group

authoringInterpretation: Node policy approval is resolved within the cited approved profiles. Empty requiredDecisions does not imply runtime support or publication approval. All unbound handlerId values, numeric tables, runtimeValidated=false and publishable=false remain unchanged.
